Text: Be tender with Your children, Lord, and show Your infinite goodness to all who ask. [t] That they will boast in You, our Creator and author of providence. [*] With them in mind, restore what has been created, and preserve what has been renewed
Changes: 2025-07-13 - Paul Prins: Refreshed translation and uses collect ending.
